en.topic_title: Hong Kong to face 130k manpower shortage in 2028 – 50k less than previously projected
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong is expected to face a manpower shortage of around 130,000 by 2028, new government figures have revealed – a significant drop from the last official projection.
